title: 桃園機場捷運
summary: 以桃園機場捷運的機場、都市及沿線通勤需求為背景，建立快慢車共享走廊的時間表。旅客攜帶行李會同時影響車門交換、垂直移動與安檢服務；課程要求以事件表追蹤延誤傳播，而非只比較行車速度。
summaryEn: Use the Taoyuan airport corridor to build an express and commuter timetable on shared infrastructure. Baggage affects door exchange, vertical circulation and processing queues together. Track disruption propagation through event tables, including passengers arriving from flights, rather than comparing train speeds alone or assuming every passenger moves at the same rate.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 catch_time=1248 s；單元 2 得 equivalent_demand=199.2 equivalent persons；單元 3 得 dwell=25.02083 s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 gap 的擾動測試，結果改為 1372.8 s；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以桃園機場捷運的機場、都市及沿線通勤需求為背景，建立快慢車共享走廊的時間表。旅客攜帶行李會同時影響車門交換、垂直移動與安檢服務；課程要求以事件表追蹤延誤傳播，而非只比較行車速度。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives catch_time=1248 s; unit 2 gives equivalent_demand=199.2 equivalent persons; unit 3 gives dwell=25.02083 s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing gap in the first unit changes its result to 1372.8 s. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Taoyuan airport corridor to build an express and commuter timetable on shared infrastructure. Baggage affects door exchange, vertical circulation and processing queues together. Track disruption propagation through event tables, including passengers arriving from flights, rather than comparing train speeds alone or assuming every passenger moves at the same rate. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 快慢車追及與待避與行李旅客與等效交換需求
stages.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up & Luggage and effective passenger exchange
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「快慢車追及與待避」與「行李旅客與等效交換需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fast-slow train catch-up" and "Luggage and effective passenger exchange": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「快慢車追及與待避」如何影響桃園機場捷運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fast-slow train catch-up” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taoyuan Airport MRT”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。這個簡單關係能辨認待避需求，但實際時刻表還需加入停站、進路鎖閉與加減速；追及點不是允許兩車接近的安全距離。 追趕時間取決於起始間隔和兩列相對速度，不能只看快車速度。若兩列會停站或受訊號限制，速度必須改成分段函數，並把進路占用放回事件圖。 比較快車追上慢車的時刻與可用待避路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「快慢車追及與待避」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. This relation identifies the need for overtaking opportunities, but real timetables also include stops, route locking and acceleration. The meeting point is not a permitted safe separation between trains. Catch-up time depends on starting separation and relative speed, not only the faster train’s speed. If either train stops or encounters signalling constraints, use piecewise speed functions and restore route occupation to the event diagram. Compare the time when an express catches a commuter train with available passing routes. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fast-slow train catch-up” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「快慢車追及與待避」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fast-slow train catch-up”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「快慢車追及與待避」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fast-slow train catch-up" is correct?
options: 快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量
快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。
機場列車只要乘客總數相同就一定具有相同停站需求
optionsEn: Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed.
Airport trains with equal passenger totals necessarily have equal dwell demand.
quiz.explanation: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快慢車追及與待避」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fast-slow train catch-up” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 13728 m，其餘固定，結果為 1372.8 s。模型邊界：同向恆速且快車較快；不含號誌保護和停站。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12480 m; fast=28 m/s; slow=18 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=1248 s. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13728 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1372.8 s. Model boundary: Same-direction constant speeds with a faster following train; signalling protection and stops are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「快慢車追及與待避」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fast-slow train catch-up” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。 以逐站到發時刻重建距離時間圖，核對起始間隔和各段速度，並標示待避占用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times. Rebuild a distance-time diagram from station arrivals and departures, verifying initial separation and segment speeds and marking passing occupation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：增加慢車停站與快車出發延後各一個情境，畫出時空圖，討論待避線能解決的衝突與仍存在的交叉進路限制。 再以本單元 gap 的對照值重算 catch_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a slow-train stop and a delayed fast departure as separate cases, draw time-distance diagrams, and distinguish conflicts solved by a loop from remaining crossing-route restrictions. Also recalculate catch_time for the alternative gap value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Also recalculate catch_time for the alternative gap value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「快慢車追及與待避」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fast-slow train catch-up"?
options: 用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。

optionsEn: Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.

quiz.explanationEn: Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 快慢車追及與待避：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fast-slow train catch-up: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快慢車追及與待避」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fast-slow train catch-up” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 快慢車速度相同時不能用追趕公式分母，須重設工況。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. Equal train speeds invalidate the catch-up denominator; redefine the operating case. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較快車追上慢車的時刻與可用待避路徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare the time when an express catches a commuter train with available passing routes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「車門交換與停站時間」與「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Door exchange and dwell time" and "Transfer walking and connection margin": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車門交換與停站時間」如何影響桃園機場捷運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Door exchange and dwell time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taoyuan Airport MRT”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 用行李占用車門附近空間的情境檢查最慢門組。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車門交換與停站時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Test the slowest door group when baggage occupies space beside the train doors. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Door exchange and dwell time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=250 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.02083 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=250 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.02083 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車門交換與停站時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Door exchange and dwell time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 車門交換與停站時間
knowledge.text: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。
knowledge.textEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Door exchange and dwell time" is correct?
options: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。
每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異
轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
optionsEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure.
Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
quiz.explanation: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車門交換與停站時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Door exchange and dwell time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=250 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.02083 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 275至 275 persons，其餘固定，結果為 26.32292 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=250 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.02083 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 275, to 275 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 26.32292 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=250 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.02083 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 275至 275 persons，其餘固定，結果為 26.32292 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=250 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.02083 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 275, to 275 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 26.32292 s. quiz.question: 依「車門交換與停站時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=250 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.02083 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車門交換與停站時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Door exchange and dwell time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation.

knowledge.textEn: Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「車門交換與停站時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Door exchange and dwell time"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低
逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell.
quiz.explanation: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 車門交換與停站時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Door exchange and dwell time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車門交換與停站時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Door exchange and dwell time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：用行李占用車門附近空間的情境檢查最慢門組。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Test the slowest door group when baggage occupies space beside the train doors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。
knowledge.textEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「車門交換與停站時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Door exchange and dwell time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
optionsEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
quiz.explanation: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」如何影響桃園機場捷運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer walking and connection margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taoyuan Airport MRT”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 把航廈步行、電扶梯與候車拆成可獨立量測的轉乘區段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Split terminal walking, escalator travel and waiting into separately measurable transfer stages. knowledge.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕
knowledge.text: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。
knowledge.textEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Round-trip time and fleet size” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taoyuan Airport MRT”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。備用車和維修車需另列；只用單程行車時間會把車隊需求低估接近一半。 循環時間除以班距後必須向上取整，半列車不能提供完整班次。此數量是投入循環的最低值，維修備用、延誤緩衝與不同分支運轉仍需額外配置。 讓終端折返與單程時間共同決定最少上線車組數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「周轉時間與車隊需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward. The cycle includes terminal turnbacks and stops. Spares and maintenance vehicles are additional; using only one-way running time can underestimate the requirement by nearly half. Divide cycle time by headway and round upward because a fraction of a train cannot provide a full departure. This is the minimum circulating requirement; maintenance spares, delay buffers and branch-specific operation need additional allocation. Use both terminal turnaround and one-way running time to estimate the minimum circulating fleet. knowledge.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求
knowledge.text: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。備用車和維修車需另列；只用單程行車時間會把車隊需求低估接近一半。
knowledge.textEn: Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward. The cycle includes terminal turnbacks and stops.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「周轉時間與車隊需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Round-trip time and fleet size" is correct?
options: 車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定
降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差
維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。
optionsEn: Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward.
quiz.explanation: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「周轉時間與車隊需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Round-trip time and fleet size” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains。敏感度：cycle 單獨增加百分之十至 6177.6 s，其餘固定，結果為 35 trains。模型邊界：固定周轉與班距、無延誤；不含備用率和維修排程。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains. Sensitivity: cycle, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 6177.6 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 35 trains. Model boundary: Fixed cycle and headway without delays; reserve ratio and maintenance scheduling are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「周轉時間與車隊需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Round-trip time and fleet size” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。 核對往返與折返時間使用同一單位，以逐列時刻表重播，檢查每次發車是否有車可用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time. Verify consistent units for round-trip and turnaround times, replay a train-by-train timetable, and check vehicle availability at every departure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：增加一端折返時間後重算車隊，檢查向上取整造成的跳變，再提出維修備用與臨時故障應如何另列。 再以本單元 cycle 的對照值重算 fleet，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase one terminal turnback time, recalculate fleet and examine rounding jumps, then explain separate allowances for maintenance reserve and unexpected failures. Also recalculate fleet for the alternative cycle value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「周轉時間與車隊需求」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Round-trip time and fleet size” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：讓終端折返與單程時間共同決定最少上線車組數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Use both terminal turnaround and one-way running time to estimate the minimum circulating fleet.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「周轉時間與車隊需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.

steps.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Speed-limit transition and warning distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「速度限制轉換與預告距離」如何影響桃園機場捷運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taoyuan Airport MRT”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。 目標速度不一定是零，進入較低速區也需要保護距離。計算使用同一距離基準與速度單位，並把定位誤差和延遲裕度分開，才能避免重複或漏加安全邊界。 區分機場站停準目標與防護用速度監督曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度限制轉換與預告距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds. A teaching deceleration gives one distance; a real protection curve additionally needs position uncertainty, gradient, brake build-up and vehicle variation. The target speed need not be zero: entry into a lower-speed section also requires protection distance. Use one distance reference and consistent speed units. Keep localisation uncertainty and delay margins separate to prevent duplicated or omitted boundaries. Separate the airport stopping target from the protective speed-supervision curve. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Speed-limit transition and warning distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=25.6 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=427.2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=25.6 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=427.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arrival variability and mean waiting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Taoyuan Airport MRT”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 當旅客隨機到站且不受容量限制時，平均等待與班距平方的期望值有關，長班距被更多旅客遇到。兩組平均班距相同的服務仍可能有不同等待時間，因此準點與均勻性具有獨立價值。 隨機到站旅客更容易遇到較長班距，因為長區間占較多時間，因此平均等候與班距變異數有關。公式假定旅客到達獨立於班表且每班可上車，不能表示服務櫃台或容量不足的隊列。 以相同平均班距但不同波動估算機場旅客的隨機到站等候。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「到站變異與平均等候」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With random passenger arrivals and no capacity constraint, mean waiting depends on the expected squared headway. More passengers encounter longer gaps. Services with identical mean headway can therefore have different waiting times, giving regularity a value separate from the average frequency. Random arrivals encounter longer headways more often because those intervals occupy more time. Mean waiting therefore depends on headway variance. The formula assumes arrivals independent of the timetable and successful boarding on every train; it does not model counters or capacity-constrained queues. Estimate random-arrival waiting for airport passengers with equal mean headway but different variability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arrival variability and mean waiting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 把旅客服務可用性與單一設備可用性分開定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用度與修復時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。
knowledge.textEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.

optionsEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用度與修復時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Availability and repair time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把旅客服務可用性與單一設備可用性分開定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Define passenger-service availability separately from the availability of one item of equipment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。
knowledge.textEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可用度與修復時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Availability and repair time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
